subjects.title: Study and Documentation of Forts and Historical Temples / Places of Worships in Local Area

units.title: Historical Importance of Forts and Temples
units.topics: Concept and types of forts, Concept of temple architecture, Tradition of forts and temples in Maharashtra, Social, political, religious, and cultural significance.

units.title: Study of Forts
units.topics: Types of forts: Hill forts, Sea forts, Land forts, Structural elements: Bastions, fortification walls, gateways, water systems, Major forts: Rajgad, Raigad, Pratapgad, Sindhudurg (case studies), Military and administrative importance.

units.title: Study of Historical Temples / Places of Worships
units.topics: Styles of temple architecture: Nagara, Dravidian, Vesara, Components of temples: Garbhagriha, Mandapa, Shikhara, Major temples: Bhimashankar, Trimbakeshwar, Pandharpur, Kolhapur (case studies), Religious practices and festivals.

units.title: Sources and Research Methods
units.topics: Written sources: Inscriptions, copper plates, texts, Oral sources: Folklore and legends, Material sources: Architectural remains, Oral history and fieldwork methods.

units.title: Documentation and Conservation
units.topics: Photography and architectural measurement, Maps and drawings, Data collection and classification, Heritage conservation and preservation, Educational and tourism relevance.

notes: Co-Curricular Course can be selected in any one semester (II / III / IV); listed under semester 2.
